method: Priority file bytes were hashed and scanned only for study_uid key/value pairs. No clinical target/state/evidence/trigger value was parsed, selected, displayed or used. The first300 ordered UIDs were checked against all six previous50-source bone packets. Positions300–349 were matched to complete original blinded input reports and independently matched against the existing hashed neutral inventory. This process-level priority-file access is disclosed and does not imply first-ever blindness.
